summary: Preserve an owned exec's exit status when it exits between the status and process-identity probes.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill; previously recorded unknown exit statuses are unchanged.

schema.detail: Uses the existing exec generation exit-code, signal and terminal fields.

rules.detail: An owned child already observed as exited is reaped and its status persisted before group completion, including while descendants remain alive. Terminal exit-code gates can therefore observe its actual result.

compatibility.detail: No command, API or stored-format change. Adopted children without a local Child handle retain existing behavior.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action required.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback; existing generation records remain readable.
